description: LoRA adapter of the weight configuration called PL-DPO-NLL in the paper (internal run name pldpo-v5-turn-focused-r32). Rank 32, alpha 32, dropout 0, on q/k/v/o/gate/up/down projections of the 32 LLaMA layers (448 tensors). Loaded with peft.PeftModel.from_pretrained onto the language model of LMDrive-LLaVA-v1.5-7B.

adapter_config.json.note: identical to the training output except base_model_name_or_path, which pointed to a path on the training server and is set to null
